component.name: Orbis Control
component.summary: Control and monitor supported ASUS laptop features on Linux

description.p: Orbis Control is a native Linux application for monitoring and controlling supported ASUS laptop capabilities.
Available controls depend on runtime capability probes and hardware evidence. Unsupported features are not presented as universally available.

First release: performance profiles, battery charge limit, custom fan curves, GPU mode switching with reboot queue, keyboard backlight and Aura static colour, Panel Overdrive, capability-gated ASUS advanced parameters, telemetry dashboard, diagnostics export and tray.
